subject: Fueling Notion's Mon/Tue/Thu office days
body: Hi there, Saw that Notion brings teams into the office three set days a week - Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday - specifically to rebuild the in-person "osmosis" that remote work strips out. That's a predictable, recurring crowd on-site every week, which is exactly the kind of rhythm that's easy to under-cater for. We run a standing weekly donut delivery timed to exactly those kinds of fixed office days, so there's always something fresh waiting without anyone having to remember to order it. Worth a 15-minute conversation to see if a Mon/Tue/Thu drop would fit your office? --- {Your Company Name} | {Your Company Address} Don't want future emails? Reply "unsubscribe."

subject: Notion's $275M raise and office snacks
body: Hi there, Notion's Series C - $275M in October 2021, led by Coatue Management and Sequoia Capital - pushed the company to a $10B valuation, and years of growth since then usually outpaces ad hoc office-service budgets. Fast-scaling teams tend to bolt on catering as an afterthought, which is how it turns inconsistent. We set up a standing donut order that scales with headcount automatically - one less thing to revisit.
